key_highlights: ASX sheds $90B in a week as rate-rise fears and oil price surge pressure miners and banks
Saudi pipeline closure after Iraqi drone attack triggers oil price spike; Australian fuel prices set to rise 30c/L
AUD weakened sharply on growth scare; iron ore entering 'bloodletting' phase
RBA flags rental inflation as key concern, complicating rate path
ANZ (ANZ.AX) restructuring 3,500 jobs; high-end housing prices correcting while affordable segment holds
Mining cap raises accelerate (Canaccord-led); small-caps PolarX, Sunstone Metals, Manuka Resources in focus
Woolworths (WOW.AX) price increases during 'Price Freeze' promotion draw consumer backlash

sectors.trend: Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; oil surge benefits energy names but weighs on broad miners. Cap raises signal distress. GDX outflows confirm risk-off. Gold underperforming ('Gold schmould').
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure from falling iron ore. Energy names (Santos, Woodside) supported by oil spike. Small-cap miners (PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka) volatile. Avoid over-exposure to iron ore; rotate into energy and gold-silver explorers (Kuniko, Gateway WA).

sectors.trend: ANZ.AX restructuring 3,500 jobs signals cost pressure. Rising bond yields and rate fears pressure valuations. Superannuation reform debate (One Nation, early access) creates policy uncertainty. 172-year-old bank token speculation noted.
sectors.implications: Big Four (CBA.AX, ANZ.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX) face margin compression from rate uncertainty. ANZ restructuring may support near-term EPS but signals structural headwinds. Super policy risk is a medium-term overhang.

sectors.trend: Oil 'explodes' as OPEC+ suppression fails; Saudi pipeline closure adds supply shock. Australia softens gas supply rules, easing Asian fears. Santos preservation noted as strategic priority.
sectors.implications: Santos (STO.AX), Woodside (WDS.AX), and oil services benefit from price spike. Gas policy flexibility supports domestic producers. Fuel cost pass-through pressures consumer sector.

sectors.trend: Woolworths price hikes during promotion erode trust. Women's clothing chain closes 177 stores. Fuel price rise (+30c) squeezes household budgets. Business confidence deteriorating.
sectors.implications: WOW.AX, WES.AX face margin and volume pressure. Consumer discretionary names vulnerable. Defensive staples (WES.AX) relatively resilient but not immune to input cost inflation.

sectors.trend: Nyxoah (NYXH.AX) BREATHE study provides catalyst. HIVE (HIV.AX) scales AI cloud via BUZZ HPC. Optus outage triggers welfare checks, highlighting telco reliability concerns. AI/tech themes active globally.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX remains defensive anchor. NYXH.AX and HIVE.AX offer speculative upside. Telcos (TPG.AX, VHC.AX) face reputational risk from outages.

sectors.trend: High-end housing prices correcting sharply; affordable segment resilient. No spring bounce in auctions. RBA rental inflation concern. Property chiefs call for more migrants. NZ correction ongoing.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) pressured by rental inflation and rate uncertainty. Developer names (MRG.AX, WBC.AX property arm) face demand softness at top end. Monitor RBA commentary on housing.

key_themes: Geopolitical oil shock (Saudi/Iraq) driving energy inflation
ASX $90B selloff on rate fears and commodity divergence
AUD weakness amplifying import costs and fuel prices
Iron ore structural decline pressuring ASX 20 heavyweights
RBA caught between rental inflation and growth scare
Superannuation policy debate creating financial sector uncertainty
Housing bifurcation: high-end correction vs affordable resilience
Mining cap raises signal capital market stress
Consumer squeeze from fuel and food price inflation

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil price spike and fuel inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour domestic gas producers with hedged revenue. Monitor OPEC+ response.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate path uncertainty / rental inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration in rate-sensitive REITs and property developers. Favour fixed-income or dividend growers.
Underweight BHP.AX, FMG.AX, RIO.AX near-term. Rotate into gold, energy, or defensive healthcare.
Favour domestic-revenue companies; avoid import-heavy retailers. AUD/USD below 0.65 is a watch trigger.
Monitor One Nation and government policy signals. Financials (CBA.AX, ANZ.AX) and fund managers (HUB.AX, PPT.AX) sensitive.
Avoid small-cap miners with active cap raises. Focus on cash-flow-positive producers.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight domestic energy and gas producers
opportunities.rationale: Oil spike and gas supply rule flexibility support STO.AX, WDS.AX earnings. Geopolitical premium likely persistent.

opportunities.recommendation: Add defensive healthcare and dividend growers
opportunities.rationale: CSL.AX and WES.AX offer resilience amid growth scare and rate uncertainty. NYXH.AX BREATHE study adds speculative upside.
Kuniko and Gateway WA discoveries in NSW/WA; gold underperforming offers entry point if USD weakness persists.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore and broad materials exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'bloodletting' and $90B ASX selloff signal continued downside for BHP, FMG, RIO.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim high-end property and REIT exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Steepest price falls at top end; RBA rental inflation concern pressures valuations. No auction bounce.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD weakness with domestic-revenue tilt
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD 'smashed' on growth scare; import-cost inflation risks consumer margins.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure over 1–3 months. Oil-driven inflation and RBA rate uncertainty cap upside. Iron ore weakness drags materials. Expect volatility around RBA commentary and US bond yields. AUD likely range-bound偏弱. Consumer sector under margin pressure from fuel and food costs.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if oil stabilises and RBA pivots. Housing bifurcation may moderate. Superannuation reform, if enacted, could support financials long-term. Energy transition and critical resources (battery tech, Kuniko) offer structural growth. Key risk: prolonged growth scare triggering recession.
